steps.title: Participant Intake
steps.instruction: Introduce yourself to the participant, hand out the questionnaire, and confirm they are available for at least 1 hour (and potentially longer).

steps.title: Hardware Setup
steps.instruction: Prepare the room and power on the necessary hardware components.

substeps.instruction: Open the window to air the room.
Turn on the three computers behind the right wall.
Turn on the projector using the remote control.
Turn on the screen on the table if necessary.

steps.title: Calibrate Tracking Equipment
steps.instruction: Prepare and verify the 3D glasses and marker system.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve the 3D-glasses and marker from Computer-III (where they are charging).
Verify that the glasses and marker are working properly.
Turn on the marker using the button on the bottom side of the marker mounted to the glasses.
Move the glasses and verify on the screen that marker 1 moves accordingly in the 3D representation (ignore marker 3).

steps.title: Initialize Software
steps.instruction: Launch the database and Vizard client software.

substeps.instruction: Turn on the database using the script file located at the left bottom of the main screen.
Start the Vizard client on the left screen: move mouse to side screen, press 'Start', type 'C', and press enter.
In the Vizard master client on the main screen, tick the boxes for clients WORLDVIZ-PC-LT and WORLDVIZ-PC-RT.
Ensure WORLDVIZ-PC-LT is positioned above WORLDVIZ-PC-RT by dragging the entries if necessary (expand the box to see full names if needed).
Set all timeouts in the lower half of the Vizard master client window to the maximum by typing as many 9's as possible.

steps.title: Stage 1 Briefing
steps.instruction: Provide the participant with the instructions for the first stage of the experiment.

substeps.instruction: Hand out the experiment description for Stage 1 and ensure the participant reads it carefully.
Answer any questions to ensure the participant understands the task (visiting 6 named buildings in a specific order using the shortest route, utilizing the 3D arrow trigger and energy bar).

steps.title: Launch Experiment
steps.instruction: Start the software session and prepare the environment.

substeps.instruction: Press 'F5' or click the play button in the top row to start.
Press 'Yes' or 'Enter' in the pop-up window to load the default experiment.
Close the window and blinds to darken the room and turn off the lights.

steps.title: Test Phase and Control Tutorial
steps.instruction: Guide the participant through the control system before starting the real experiment.

substeps.instruction: Explain that the participant is in the test phase to explore the scene.

Explain controls: Joystick forward/backward for movement, left/right for sidestepping, twisting joystick or rotating head for turning. Note that walking direction is based on participant facing, not the main screen.
Explain that the front trigger on the joystick should be pressed shortly.
Confirm the participant is comfortable; once the real experiment starts, no further questions may be answered.

steps.title: Stage 2 Briefing
steps.instruction: Provide instructions for the second stage during the break.

substeps.instruction: Open the window for ventilation.
Hand out the Stage 2 description (8 tasks repeated 5 times, including 8 training repetitions).
Explain the 8 tasks involving blue highlighted spheres, map navigation, yellow target circles, and memory/direction tasks (Tasks 1-8).
Ensure the participant understands and answer any remaining questions.

steps.title: Experiment Conclusion
steps.instruction: Manage the end of the session and participant payment.

substeps.instruction: Once tasks are complete, the screen turns black; keep it black until the participant leaves the CAVE.
Have the participant sign the participation paper and receipt.
Hand over payment (Note: pay 15 CHF per 30 minutes of overtime if the session exceeded 1 hour).

steps.title: Data Logging and Shutdown
steps.instruction: Record the participant ID and power down the system.

substeps.instruction: Press ESC to close the experiment.
Open 'participant-id.txt' on the desktop, find the start time, and identify the participant ID (the last number after the colon).
Add the ID to the survey to connect survey information to collected data.
Turn off the left computer, rapidly move the mouse to the center computer, and turn off the center computer.
Leave the right computer on.
Connect the glasses and marker to USB cables at Computer-III to charge.
Turn off the projectors.
